description: Lead piano preset. Resonance removed, gentle tube warmth, singing presence. Takes more reverb than most (slot 0 via send.set).
name: piano-sing
notes: Precondition: Piano track selected in Cubase, inserts 0-1 loaded per opencode/reference/piano-sing.md.
Send in listed order with unique numeric id per request to POST http://localhost:3001/rpc.
Response param field shows resolved Cubase title; on Parameter not found, shorten spelling.
Resonance notch / low-cut / presence shelf are manual by resolved title (same-slot duplicate Gain would overwrite).
Hall reverb is manual (no send API); see reference file.
